svg.title: edit_model — every gate, check and branch in one call
svg.desc: An invalid request, a stale base or a rejected write fails the call. Otherwise the specification, identification, model–data compatibility and predictive check groups run in order, each only when its inputs changed; every check failure is saved as a warning, and the model commits with the reports unless the branch moved.
